description: Search deals by term across selected fields. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/deals/search.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`.

exact_match.description: If true, only exact matches (case-insensitive) are returned.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to search — any of 'custom_fields', 'notes', 'title'.

organization_id.description: Restrict to deals linked to this organization id.

person_id.description: Restrict to deals linked to this person id.

status.description: Restrict to deals with this status — 'open', 'won' or 'lost'.

name: pipedrive_search_deals
title: Search deals
